name: claudinho
description: Live football in Claude Code for the competition you follow: the score or the countdown above the prompt (the same line on demand with /claudinho), a toast when a score changes, a short celebration in the band on a goal, and the live score beside your prompt for the model, all from the installed claudinho CLI's local cache. Live data: ESPN. Not affiliated with FIFA, any confederation, league or club, or Anthropic.

toasts.title: Score toasts
toasts.description: Which score changes raise a toast: pinned, your pinned team's match (claudinho follow <alias> --team <name>); with no pin saved, pinned toasts nothing. all, every live match of the competition you follow; off, none.

celebrate.title: Goal celebration
celebrate.description: On a goal the toasts announce, the band plays a short celebration; off plays nothing.
